issue: Protocol section 14 (tier rule) eliminates every Round-1 candidate -> promotion set is empty, while section 15 says 'keep at most Top-1 per family from Round 1 (max 4)'. The two readings conflict when zero configurations reach Tier S/A/B.
resolution: Run Round 2 as a FULL-PANEL DIAGNOSTIC on the Top-1 config per family (frozen configs only, no new hyperparameters, no threshold change). Rationale: the morning report is required (section 21) to answer Q5-Q9, which need 5-category x 3-seed coverage; and a CASE_C verdict resting on 3 categories x 1 seed would be too thin. The pre-registered verdict ladder and all thresholds are UNCHANGED; the section-14 outcome (zero promotions) is reported separately and governs the 'mechanical' reading.
selection_rule: per family: highest delta_dprime_vs_uniform among Round-1 candidates (tie-break: lower delta_abs_z)
round3: remains forbidden unless >=2 families reach Tier S/A on the full panel (section 15/16 condition is evaluated on the full panel for this diagnostic)
verdict_authority: section-14 mechanical reading = CASE_C (zero promotions); the full-panel diagnostic is reported alongside and cannot silently override it.
